description: Helps you decide how big your market is, counted bottom up. You give how many companies could buy and your annual contract value in dollars, plus your ICP match rate and year 1 share if you have them. You get TAM, SAM and SOM with the arithmetic and assumptions shown and a summary for an investor deck. It is a calculator, not a data source: a rate you leave out is filled with a labelled example, and sector notes are added when your inputs name a supported sector.

company.description: Optional: your company or product name, so the answer can name it

data_sources.description: Where you got your numbers (for documentation)

icp_percentage.description: Percentage of those companies that match your ICP, from 0 to 100. Left out, 30 is used and marked as an example

product_category.description: Optional: what you sell (for example "spend management software"), used for sector notes. The arithmetic does not use it

total_potential_companies.description: Estimated total companies that could buy (from LinkedIn, industry reports)

year1_market_share_target.description: Assumed Year 1 share percentage, from 0 to 100. This is a planning assumption, not evidence of attainable share. Left out, 3 is used and marked as an example

name: tam_sam_som_calculator
title: TAM SAM SOM Calculator
